Ismanna's Log Book 2501, 1 Acur My commission to research the abandoned mines west of Renault's Keep is a dream come true. Since childhood I have dreamt of putting my researching skills to good use.
伊斯曼娜的日志 2501 年，阿库尔月 1 日 受命考察雷诺要塞以西的废弃矿场，梦想成真了。我从小就梦想让自己的研究本领派上大用场。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

Even before I wrote ''Manatite and its Effects on Local Flora and Fauna, Volume 1'', I knew that this was what I wanted to do. And now, to be paid for such an honor! I cannot wait to tell Cuthen and the others. But first, I must begin my expedition. I look forward to a reprieve from this stifling heat.
早在写下《法力晶石及其对当地动植物之影响·卷一》之前，我就知道自己想干的就是这一行。如今这项荣誉还另有报酬！我迫不及待想告诉库森他们。不过首先，我得开始考察。正好借机躲开这令人窒息的酷热。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Start

2501, 2 Acur
	Even at the entrance to this mine I can sense the presence of manatite. It is a skill honed over many cycles spent among it. I have heard similar stories from other scholars and adepts. Manatite is more than just physically present. It reaches out into its environment,

2501 年，阿库尔月 2 日
	还站在矿口，我就能感觉到法力晶石的存在。这是长年浸淫其中磨出的本领。我也听过其他学者与行家讲过类似的事。法力晶石不只是物理上的存在，它还会向周遭环境延展，
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

telepathically... or I suppose not since it does not think. But it reaches out. I aim to prove this, within these mines. The time it has sat abandoned should be long enough for these effects to be clear without the disturbance of people.
以心灵感应的方式……呃，也许不算，毕竟它不会思考。但它确实在向外延伸。我打算在这些矿井里证明这一点。矿场荒废这么久，无人打扰，这些效应理应显现得足够清晰。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[4]
Start

2501, 5 Acur
	I am witnessing things that are, to my knowledge, yet unseen by any living man or woman. Crystal growths are present all over the mine, especially near high concentrations of manatite. They are not manatite themselves, yet they give off the same light. I have never seen such a thing. Much further study is needed.

2501 年，阿库尔月 5 日
	我正目睹据我所知尚无人得见的事物。整座矿场到处生着水晶状结物，在法力晶石聚集之处尤为密集。它们本身并非法力晶石，却散发着同样的光。我从未见过这种东西，还需大量研究。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[5]
Start

2501, 7 Acur
	I have decided to call the crystals ismannatite. Vain, I know. I cannot help it. Should I be ashamed that my dedication and hard work have led me to new discoveries? Perhaps I shall not name it after myself in the end, but for now, it brings me great joy.

2501 年，阿库尔月 7 日
	我决定把这些晶体命名为「伊斯曼晶石」。我知道，这有些自恋。可我忍不住。难道我的勤勉与苦功带来了新发现，我还该羞愧不成？也许最终不会以我的名字命名，但眼下，它让我高兴极了。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[6]
Start

2501, 10 Acur
	It moves. Ismannatite may appear motionless, but it is not. I have taken precise measurements across multiple samples. My findings are confirmed. It shifts left or right, up or down, only slight amounts at a time, but it does move. I have heard sounds from deeper into the mines as well. I am frightened, but my curiosity has gotten the better of me. Perhaps, also my pride. I shall investigate cautiously.

2501 年，阿库尔月 10 日
	它会在动。伊斯曼晶石看似静止，实则不然。我对多份样本做了精确测量，结论确凿：它会向左或向右、向上或向下平移，幅度极小，但确实在动。我还听见矿井深处传来声响。我害怕，但好奇心占了上风，也许还有好胜心。我会小心勘查的。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[7]
Start

2501, 11 Acur
	This is a momentous discovery indeed! Ismannatite is alive, or something like it. I saw the creatures for myself while investigating the noises. They are formed of the crystal itself, yet bound only by energy. While mostly unconcerned with me, I dare not get any closer to them. Tomorrow I shall make my retreat.

2501 年，阿库尔月 11 日
	这真是重大的发现！伊斯曼晶石是活的，或者类似活物。循着那些声响调查时，我亲眼看见了那些生物。它们由晶体本身构成，却仅凭能量维系。它们大多对我漠不关心，可我也不敢再靠近一步。明天我就撤。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[8]
Start

This cannot be... the mineshaft I entered through has collapsed. Surely I would have heard such a noise... perhaps it happened while I slept. There are many paths, and I know not which one to take. Leunamar guide me... my pride has gotten the best of me. Am I to become an example to others? I must ensure that my findings survive.
怎么会这样……我进来的那条矿井塌了。这么大的动静，我不该听不见……也许是趁我睡着时塌的。岔路这么多，我不知道该走哪一条。卢纳玛尔，请指引我……是好胜心害了我。难道我要成为后人引以为戒的例子？我必须让我的发现留存下去。
res#60444/whatIHaveToSay[9]
Start

I will stash this log book in the nearest crate and pray for a way out. If I fail... I hope that my research does some good in this world.


Ismanna, Manatite Researcher for the Bryston Estate
2501, 12 Acur

我把这本日志藏进最近的木箱，祈求能找到生路。若我失败……但愿我的研究能对这个世界有所裨益。


伊斯曼娜，布里斯顿庄园的法力晶石研究员
2501 年，阿库尔月 12 日
